sources.title: RLUSD escrow today: AllowTrustLineLocking issuer permission and TEST-SGD
sources.body:
Not today: an XRPL escrow can hold official RLUSD only after its issuer enables AllowTrustLineLocking, and the RLUSD issuer had not enabled it on Mainnet or Testnet when the team checked on 11 November 2026. The TokenEscrow amendment (XLS-85), which lets an escrow hold issued tokens, is already enabled on both networks, so the issuer flag is the remaining blocker. Only the issuer can set that flag, with an AccountSet transaction; a buyer or writer cannot set it for them. [1] [2] [3] [4] [5]

RLUSD escrow support cannot be inferred from an XRP key-reveal purchase. An issuer can change its flags later, so check the issuer account on the intended network before relying on this answer. The docs contain no verified list of Singapore banks piloting RLUSD settlement in 2026. We cannot name banks from this evidence. [3] [4]

The issuer is separate from buyer and writer. Policy rejects issuer-as-party, missing permission, nonzero transfer fees, frozen/unauthorized lines, insufficient balance or destination limit before create signing. This is a conservative subset of XLS-85: no transfer-fee arithmetic or freeze exception is claimed. Settlement checks the writer RippleState balance delta (currency, issuer, sign and exact value), never the requested Amount as proof of delivery. Cancellation checks the buyer's returned balance delta. The buyer retains its original budget reservation while an outcome is unresolved.

Build note, TEST-SGD stand-in: our alternative is TEST-SGD, an IOU issued by our own Testnet issuer with no real value. It stands in for RLUSD in a mechanism experiment; it is neither official RLUSD nor evidence of stablecoin adoption. S$ prices map 1:1 to TEST-SGD; this is neither a peg nor a backing claim. The experimental issuer enables token locking before the buyer and writer establish eligible trust lines. A successful TEST-SGD escrow proves only that this configured stand-in worked on Testnet; it does not change the official RLUSD issuer's permissions or establish a live bank settlement partnership. Sources accessed 11 November 2026.
